screened_mechanisms.scope: host + 4 PostPass::LayerFinalization core guests (zero WIT changes)
screened_mechanisms.summary: Zero-clone host LayerCollectionViewData::from_ir_shared (std::mem::take -> Arc -> Arc::try_unwrap restore), lazy OnceCell LayerCollectionView::ordered_entities in slicer-sdk/slicer-macros, skirt-brim .take(needed_layers), and part-cooling hoisted cooling_decision_for_event.
Zero-alloc exact decimal formatter (push_fixed_trimmed / push_fixed_e5 with midpoint guard and core::fmt fallback) + Rayon chunk-parallel serialize_gcode using backward-scanned seed_e_accumulator.

Parallel drop(layer_irs) via Rayon, parallel zero-alloc simplify_and_prune_indices, pre-allocated commands + indexed annotations, single-pass parallelized estimator, PrintEstimate reuse across GCodePostProcess gated by parallel kinematic invariance check, and parallel ;LAYER_CHANGE scan in run.rs.

deferred_wit_leads.reason: WIT run(commands: list<gcode-command>) passes 102K-977K commands by value and re-emits them via 102K-977K host push calls solely to prepend start G-code and append end G-code (+2 cmds). Fixing at the root requires an additive WIT resource-backed gcode-stream-view + push-input-range(start, end).

part-cooling inspects only path.role == BridgeInfill (zero point coordinates read), yet current WIT layer-collection-view exposes only ordered-entities() with full polyline point arrays. Fixing requires an additive WIT query such as layer-has-role / entity-roles.
